quote: DP World has added three new RTGs to its terminal in Caucedo, Dominican Republic, increasing the fleet to 35 units. … The new RTGs, supplied by ZPMC, represent a US$7.9m investment, according to Manuel Martínez, CEO of DP World Dominicana.
note: Opened WorldCargo News 4 Jul 2025 Caucedo ZPMC RTG delivery article.
